title: Integrating WGCNA and network pharmacology to unravel the multi-target mechanisms of Ludangshen Oral liquid against nephrotic syndrome: Involvement of TGF-beta1/Smad3 and gut microbiota.
authors: Cheng, Zhuoyang; Xiang, Wenping; Chen, Xinyue; Xu, Xiexin; Hou, Wenyu; Gao, Jianping; Zhou, Jiangtao
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药口服液治疗肾病综合征的多靶点机制，虽含分子对接与MD模拟，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Ludangshen oral liquid (LDSKFY, abbreviated from the pinyin initials of "Ludangshen Koufuye") is a traditional Chinese medicinal product clinically used to treat chronic nephritis. This study aimed to investigate the therapeutic effects of LDSKFY on nephrotic syndrome (NS) and its underlying mechanisms. UPLC-MS was used to analyze the chemical composition to identify the active components of LDSKFY. An integrated approach combining weighted gene co-expression network analysis (WGCNA) and network pharmacology was employed to predict its potential mechanisms against NS. The protective effects of LDSKFY were further evaluated both in vivo and in vitro, using an Adriamycin (ADR)-induced NS model in SD rats and an ADR-induced fibrosis model in HBZY-1 cells, respectively. Renal histopathology was examined to assess morphological changes. Western blot and RT-qPCR were conducted to assess TGF-beta1/Smad3 pathway-related proteins and mRNA expression. Additionally, 16S rRNA gene sequencing technology was used to investigate the gut microbiota research to identify microbial changes in rat fecal samples. The interactions between active components and key targets were further validated through molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulations. UPLC-MS analysis identified 20 important active components, and network pharmacology predictions suggested their mechanism of action was associated with the TGF-beta signaling pathway. In vivo results indicated that LDSKFY reduced kidney index and histopathological grading in ADR-induced NS. Furthermore, LDSKFY significantly decreased the levels of 24-h urinary protein (24 h-TP), 24-h microalbumin (24 h-mALB), triglyceride (TG), cholesterol (CHO), blood urea nitrogen (BUN), and serum creatinine (CRE), while increasing total protein (TP) and albumin (ALB), indicating improved renal function. In vitro, LDSKFY effectively restored the expression of podocyte-specific markers nephrin and synaptopodin and suppressed desmin expression in HBZY-1 cells. Mechanistically, LDSKFY prevents the activation of the TGF-beta1/Smad3 pathway in both renal tissue and cells. In addition, gut microbiota analysis revealed that LDSKFY treatment promoted a more stable gut microbial community structure. Molecular docking and dynamics simulations confirmed that multiple active components of LDSKFY stably bound to key targets including TGF-beta1, Smad3, and Smad7. Our findings elucidate the multi-target mechanisms of LDSKFY against NS, involving the TGF-beta1/Smad3 pathway and gut microbiota modulation, which provides a theoretical basis for its clinical application in the treatment of chronic nephritis and NS.
abstract_zh: 潞党参口服液（LDSKFY，取自“Ludangshen Koufuye”拼音首字母）是一种临床上用于治疗慢性肾炎的中药产品。本研究旨在探讨LDSKFY对肾病综合征（NS）的治疗效果及其潜在机制。采用UPLC-MS分析其化学成分，以鉴定LDSKFY的活性成分。结合加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA）和网络药理学，预测其对抗NS的潜在机制。进一步通过体内和体外实验评估LDSKFY的保护作用，分别使用阿霉素（ADR）诱导的SD大鼠NS模型和ADR诱导的HBZY-1细胞纤维化模型。通过肾脏组织病理学检查评估形态学变化。采用Western blot和RT-qPCR评估TGF-beta1/Smad3通路相关蛋白及mRNA表达。此外，利用16S rRNA基因测序技术进行肠道菌群研究，以检测大鼠粪便样本中的微生物变化。通过分子对接和分子动力学模拟进一步验证活性成分与关键靶点之间的相互作用。UPLC-MS分析鉴定出20种重要活性成分，网络药理学预测其作用机制与TGF-beta信号通路相关。体内结果表明，LDSKFY降低了ADR诱导NS大鼠的肾脏指数和组织病理学分级。此外，LDSKFY显著降低24小时尿蛋白（24 h-TP）、24小时微量白蛋白（24 h-mALB）、甘油三酯（TG）、胆固醇（CHO）、血尿素氮（BUN）和血清肌酐（CRE）水平，同时增加总蛋白（TP）和白蛋白（ALB），表明肾功能改善。体外实验中，LDSKFY有效恢复HBZY-1细胞中足细胞特异性标志物nephrin和synaptopodin的表达，并抑制desmin表达。机制上，LDSKFY在肾组织和细胞中均阻止TGF-beta1/Smad3通路的激活。此外，肠道菌群分析显示，LDSKFY治疗促进了更稳定的肠道微生物群落结构。分子对接和动力学模拟证实，LDSKFY的多种活性成分与关键靶点（包括TGF-beta1、Smad3和Smad7）稳定结合。我们的研究结果阐明了LDSKFY对抗NS的多靶点机制，涉及TGF-beta1/Smad3通路和肠道菌群调节，为其在慢性肾炎和NS治疗中的临床应用提供了理论基础。
